title: Which Bad Lieutenant movie do you prefer and why?

commenti.body:
Well I know that neither movie are truly connected (as in a legitimate sequel) and that Herzog merely took the title in what looks to me to be an almost spoof while at the same time homage to American crime films.  Some involved with the original Bad Lieutenant were upset about this. 

That being said I haven't seen Bad Lieutenant in maybe over a decade.  But Herzog's film I saw a year ago.

I'm a big Herzog fan, but I avoided that film because I guess I kinda took the bait and thought it'd be a rather typical crime drama.  I was so wrong! It's just as odd as Stroszek; it has that same charm of being in love with the absolute tragicomedy that is America

Nicolas Cage is over the top in the best possible ways.  Oh and I love his (wife?  Or someone's wife) who is a TV watching beeraholic.  We simply don't see that kind of thing enough.  A typical alcoholic woman in film is more prone to drinking wine and spirits.  
And now I'm recalling the drug induced hallucinations.  Those are also perfect and sort of fill a void concerning hallucinations in film, which are often as poorly conceived as the average dream sequence (sidenote:  my favorite dream sequence in any movie is from Ingmar Bergman's Crys and Whispers.)
